content: Python+MQL5 dual-process trading bots: common failure mode is desynchronization between Python script and MT5 terminal -- any interruption (power outage, internet disconnect, software update, system restart) on either side can cause missed trades or orphaned positions (one leg of a hedge open without the other, or stale signals acted upon). Architecture pattern: keep trading logic in Python, minimal EA in MT5 terminal as relay -- but this concentrates risk in the Python process staying alive. No mature off-the-shelf heartbeat/timeout pattern found in public sources; must be custom-built (matches project's own spec recommendation of EA-side heartbeat timeout falling back to manage-only mode).
